ci_finding.resolution: The self-checks moved to tests/cognitive_os/learning/test_surface_audit.py, 19 tests, where they run in CI on every push rather than only when someone executes the module. No check was dropped.
ci_finding.verified: bandit -r src/cognitive_os reports 0 high and 2 medium, the same as before D1
ci_finding.why_it_was_missed: bandit was not run locally before the push; ruff, mypy and the schema export were.

s21d1_041_coding_adapter.source: the 60 historical correction trajectories resolved in W3a, read from the C3 store
s21d1_041_coding_adapter.split_read_from: the recorded correctness field, not from step positions
s21d1_041_coding_adapter.split_rule: a correction trajectory records both sides in one ordered sequence, so the failed graph is the prefix through the last step the verifier marked incorrect and the successful graph is the whole trajectory

s21d1_042_domain_adapter.source: the persisted step assessments of the 40 fresh compilations in the D1 store
s21d1_042_domain_adapter.why_not_re_running: re-executing a case produces a different trajectory and would silently detach the graph from the pair set frozen in W3c. Projecting from persisted assessments keeps every graph tied to the trajectory that was actually stored.

s21d1_046_persistence.store: the existing Artifact Store on the D1 evidence pair

measured_basis.query_pattern: the retrieval arms load the root manifest once and rank in memory over at most 80 candidates, well inside the 2-second query budget

s21d1_047_migration_decision.reasoning: PostgreSQL already holds dataset and lineage identity through the existing learned tables, and the Artifact Store already holds the payload bytes with content-addressed deduplication and verification. No query or integrity requirement was found that this representation cannot meet. Backlog section 4.8 is explicit that convenience is not sufficient, and nothing here is more than convenience.
